reviews.review: The game goes from boring to OMFG!! So, if you are playing solo, you get boring or die.

This game is a lot of fun, but it's way too short and there are some strange things that I describe below.  I'd recommend the game if you can get it on sale.

Also, there are some other weird things about the game that you should know ahead of time.  It's meant to be a multi-player game and they didn't make any changes for when you're playing by yourself.  For instance, it makes sense if you're playing with other people that you can't pause the game, but I prefer to play by myself and I still can't pause the game, which is very frustrating.  Each mission can take 20-35 or so minutes, so you have to commit to that time (and ignore your kids, spouse, pet, etc.)  From what I can tell, it doesn't save in the middle of a mission either.  You can't even manually save.  It only does auto-saves, which I never trust.  How can they not make these simple changes for playing single player?  It just feels completely lazy.  Another strange thing is that there are "challenge cards".  They allow you to get special powers or make the game more challenging.  Interesting concept, but I think they did it because they realized the game is too short, so they're trying to get you to replay the same missions several times, which is pretty boring.  Also, you "buy" the cards... and they're free.  Why free?  Why not just give them to you instead of making you go to a store?  Did these used to cost real world money?  My final comment on the strange things is that when you're setting up everything to play a single player game, it starts a countdown like it would in a multiplayer game, but I'm being rushed for no reason because I'm by myself.  Again, laziness on the part of the developer.  As I originally said, buy it if you can get it on sale.  Right now, it's $30 and I wouldn't buy it for that much.

The whole point of this game for me was to play it with my friend. We have played some other games together with no issues but for some reason we could only find each other once. There might be some weird fix for this but we don't really have the time to make it work. I guess buy the game and try it but be careful not to pass the 14 day or the 2 hour playtime mark because apparently it's very important even if the game is totally useless to you afterwards.

"Aliens: Fireteam Elite" is a thrilling cooperative shooter game that immerses players in a tense, claustrophobic environment. Players are part of a fireteam sent to face Xenomorphs, and the game encourages teamwork and customization of classes. The graphics are solid, capturing the gritty, dark aesthetic of the films, and the sound design is excellent, with alien sounds and background music setting the mood. However, repetitive mission designs can detract from the experience. Playing with friends keeps the game fresh and fun. If you enjoy cooperative shooters and are a fan of Aliens, "Aliens: Fireteam Elite" is worth checking out. Grab a squad and have a blast!
